blocks.text: Hum aam istemal hone wala Cartesian coordinate system parh chuke hain. Asal mein frame of reference koi bhi coordinate system hai jis ke nisbat paimaishein li jati hain. Maslan kamre mein mez ki jagah kamre ki deewaron ke nisbat bayan ho sakti hai, yun kamra frame of reference hai. Isi tarah laboratory wahan li gayi paimaishon ka frame hai; agar wahi tajruba chalti train mein ho to train frame of reference ban jati hai. Spaceship ki jagah door ke sitaron ke nisbat bayan ho sakti hai, yun in sitaron par mabni coordinate system frame of reference banta hai.
Inertial aur non-inertial frames of reference

blocks.title: Inertial frame of reference
blocks.text: Inertial frame of reference aisa coordinate system hai jis mein jumood (inertia) ka qanoon durust ho: aaram mein jism aaram mein rehta hai jab tak us par acceleration paida karne wali na-mutawazan (unbalanced) force na lage. Fitrat ke doosre qawaneen bhi aise nizam mein lagu hote hain.

Zameen par rakha jism aaram mein rehta hai jab tak us par na-mutawazan force na lage, jo dikhata hai ke Zameen ko inertial frame mana ja sakta hai. Zameen ke nisbat yaksan velocity se chalti gari mein rakha jism bhi aaram mein rehta hai, to gari bhi inertial frame hai. Yun inertial frame ke nisbat yaksan velocity se chalta har frame bhi inertial hai.

blocks.title: Non-inertial frame of reference
blocks.text: Agar chalti gari achanak ruke ya tez ho to andar ka jism aaram mein nahi rehta; tab gari inertial frame nahi. Tez hota (accelerated) frame of reference non-inertial frame hai.

Zameen ghoomti aur Suraj ke gird chakkar lagati hai, jo usool mein ise non-inertial banata hai, magar us ka acceleration kam hone ki wajah se ise aksar inertial frame mana jata hai. Relativity is baat ka mutala hai ke chalte frames of reference ke observers duniya ko kaise dekhte hain (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: Frame of reference se kya muraad hai? Misalon ke saath inertial aur non-inertial frames mein farq bataiye (comprehensive question 11.1; short question 11.1).
blocks.explanation: Frame of reference aisa coordinate system hai jis ke nisbat jagahein aur harkatein napi jati hain, jaise kamra, laboratory, chalti train ya door ke sitare. Inertial frame mein jumood ka qanoon durust hai: aaram mein jism aaram mein rehta aur chalta jism apni velocity rakhta hai jab tak na-mutawazan force na lage; misalein Zameen, achi had tak, aur yaksan velocity se chalti gari. Non-inertial frame tez ho raha hota hai: achanak brake lagati gari mein dheela thaila aage sarakta hai halanke koi force use nahi dhakelti, to wahan jumood ka qanoon nakaam hai.

items: Frame of reference: paimaishon ke liye koi bhi coordinate system (kamra, laboratory, train, sitare). Inertial: jumood ka qanoon durust (Zameen taqreeban, yaksan velocity par gari); inertial frame ke nisbat yaksan chalta har frame inertial. Non-inertial: tez hota (brake lagati ya tez hoti gari); Zameen usooli taur par non-inertial magar taqreeban inertial.
